brief.zh: 标出这句话的主语、谓语和宾语。
brief.en: Mark the subject, the verb and the object of this sentence.

showcase: marking: a stretch is chosen with two taps and then marked as a role

t.zh: 论文里的长句读不下去，多半是因为找不到它的<wiki-ref to="skeleton"></wiki-ref>：谁、做了什么、对什么。在这里，你把一句话拆开，直到主干露出来。
t.en: A long sentence in a paper is hard going mostly because its <wiki-ref to="skeleton"></wiki-ref> is hard to find: who, does what, to what. Here you take a sentence apart until the skeleton shows.

t.zh: 点一个词开始选一段，再点另一个词结束，中间的词就都选上了；只要一个词，就点它一下。选好以后，在下面把它标成主干的一个成分。
t.en: Tap a word to start a stretch and another to end it, and every word between is chosen; for one word, tap it once. Then mark it below as a part of the skeleton.

t.zh: 和标整个名词短语，比如 Our method；标整个动词词组。
t.en: The and the are marked as whole noun phrases, such as Our method; the as the whole verb group.

hint.zh: 先找动词：哪个词说的是“做了什么”？
hint.en: Find the verb first: which word says what is done?

sentence: Our method outperforms all existing baselines.

title.zh: Our method outperforms all existing baselines.
title.en: Our method outperforms all existing baselines.

body.zh: 主语 Our method，谓语 outperforms，宾语 all existing baselines：这就是整句的主干。句子再长，主干也只有这几块，其余的词都挂在它们身上。
body.en: Subject Our method, verb outperforms, object all existing baselines: that is the whole skeleton. However long a sentence gets, its skeleton is these few pieces; every other word hangs on them.

note.zh: 主干 = 谁 + 做什么 + 对什么。
note.en: Skeleton = who + does what + to what.
